items.name: Notification / alert receivers
items.reason: Alertmanager is not deployed in docker-compose.live.yml and receiver secrets (Slack webhook, PagerDuty keys, SMTP credentials) are not configured in the local surrogate. Config files exist under monitoring/alertmanager/ but were not exercised.

items.name: Telemetry dashboards / metrics
items.reason: Prometheus/Grafana/Loki are not deployed locally. Metrics endpoints were verified reachable on L4 (200), L5 (200), and L6 (200); L2/L3 return 503 (auth-gated) and L1 returns 404. Dashboards and alert rules were not validated end-to-end.

items.name: Billing / Stripe webhooks
items.reason: No billing service or Stripe integration is deployed in the local surrogate; CLERK_WEBHOOK_SECRET is unset and there are no Stripe keys. Webhook path exists only in the API gateway (services/api/app/core) and was not exercised.

items.name: Performance / SLO smoke
items.reason: scripts/e2e/critical_path_smoke.py --host passed 12/0 after rollback recovery. No explicit latency SLO thresholds are defined in this environment; gate confirms critical path is functional under light load.

items.name: Live LLM provider path
items.reason: OPENAI_API_KEY and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY are unset in the running Layer 4 container. A real LLM call cannot be validated without provider credentials or a sandbox LLM.

items.name: Production-safety / auth fail-closed
items.reason: Scanned vf-live-layer4 environment for dev auth bypass flags (DEV_AUTH_BYPASS, ALLOW_DEV_AUTH_BYPASS, AUTH_BYPASS_ENABLED, ALLOW_INSECURE_DEV_AUTH_BYPASS) — none present. Unauthenticated and invalid-token requests to /api/v1/workflows returned HTTP 401.

items.name: Log aggregation / tracing
items.reason: Fluent-bit/Loki/Jaeger are not deployed locally. Services emit structured logs to stdout/stderr only. Sentry is disabled because VITE_SENTRY_DSN is unset.

recommendation: P1 operational readiness is incomplete in the local surrogate. Items marked DEFERRED must be exercised in a production-like environment with real provider credentials, observability stack, and billing sandbox before Core GA.
